criteria.statement: Deterministic source-section audit checks prove no relevant source section is omitted or double-counted and verify explicit reconciliation, section 27, section 11, sections 35–36, mutation-testing, and D1 classifications.
Deterministic roadmap checks prove the complete future-ExecPlan contract, P0–P7/D1 structure, dependencies, P4 BLOCKED state, and D1 exclusion from active prerequisites.
Git path inspection proves no implementation-bearing file changed and no P0 workstream plan was created or executed.
Negative checks prove duplicate source-section IDs, an active benchmark authorization, and an omitted reconciliation row would fail the reconciliation rules.
